description:
Shadow Man Remastered randomizer for Archipelago.
Collect Dark Souls to open coffin gates and power the five Engine Blocks,
then defeat Legion to complete the game. Goal completion is detected
automatically — the client watches for Legion's death in-game and
reports it to the server (see client.py's _goal_watcher_loop).

v0.1.0.description:
# Shadow Man Remastered AP World v0.1.0 - Initial Beta Release

The first public release of a full [Archipelago](https://archipelago.gg) multiworld implementation of **Shadow Man Remastered**, sharing its core byte-level patching engine with the [standalone single-player randomizer](https://github.com/bropacman/shadow-man-remastered-randomizer) but built as its own separate project - see "How This Differs From the Standalone Randomizer" in the [README](https://github.com/bropacman/shadow-man-remastered-ap-world#readme) for where the two diverge.

**This is a beta.** It's been tested solo so far - no other players or multiworld rooms yet. Versioned as `v0.1.0` rather than `v1.0.0` on purpose: treat it as early, expect rough edges, and please file anything you hit (see Known Issues and How to Report Bugs below).

## What's New

### Goal
Defeat Legion. Reach him by collecting enough Dark Souls to open the coffin gates blocking Deadside progress and completing the five Engine Blocks (or, with Piston Combo Randomizer on, also finding and reading Jack's Schematic to learn that seed's randomized piston combination). Your client reports `goal complete` automatically the moment Legion is confirmed dead.

### Progression & Logic
- Coffin gate soul requirements shuffled via configurable presets (story through chaos), with caps/overrides for multiworld reliability
- Deadside portal shuffle (`deadside_only` - the 9 Deadside hub portals shuffled among themselves)
- Dark Engine piston combo randomization, with Jack's Schematic becoming required progression when enabled
- In-game soul-level thresholds can be randomized (progressive/balanced/fully random), with AP's own logic staying in sync with whatever's actually patched into the exe
- Progression balancing control over how aggressively key items are pushed toward deeper locations

### Cadeaux as AP Checks
- Optional: turn on "Cadeaux Key Items" and all 666 cadeaux locations become real AP checks, bundleable into grouped checks of your choosing
- Optional Fogometers Light Soul gate as its own AP check

### Cosmetic & Optional Shuffles
Weapons, lore items, the Light Soul, enemy types (with difficulty-weighted/full/contextual modes), true forms, ambient creatures, music, voice lines, weapon SFX, enemy SFX, and sky textures - all independently toggleable.

### Gameplay Tweaks (EXE patch, applied at seed-apply time)
Force "I Like Dead Side Guns," starting health, life altar health grant, altar/Fogometers cadeaux costs, death penalty, and Shift-sprint - same patching engine as the standalone randomizer's own Gameplay Tuning options.

### Traps & Bonuses (AP-only)
Filler items that apply a random temporary or permanent effect on receipt - cosmetic secrets, a health poison/heal, a voodoo power drain/hold, or an ammo drain/hold. Fully optional (off by default) with each effect category toggleable independently.

### Multiplayer
Standard Death Link support, with an optional throttle on how many of your own deaths it takes to send one.

### Client Tracking
The Shadow Man AP client has its own built-in status tab - level, locations checked, Dark Souls/Soul Level, Cadeaux, Gad Powers, health, and a per-level completion breakdown - plus a "Proximity to Go Mode" panel showing your remaining goal prerequisites and live Engine Block region reachability at a glance. Full [Universal Tracker](https://github.com/FarisTheAce/UniversalTracker) integration is also supported when its apworld is installed alongside this one.

### AP Companion Tool
A standalone Windows exe (`shadow_man_ap_companion.exe`, no Python required) for both ends of setup: a "Generate YAML" tab with tooltips and a live preview for building your player options file, and an "Apply AP Seed" tab for patching your generated `.apshadowman` seed onto your local game install.

## How This Differs From the Standalone Randomizer
- No single graded "insanity tier" - the same ground (cadeaux, barrels, weapon/lore/bonus) is covered by separate independent options instead
- `cross_hub` entrance mode isn't ported yet (`deadside_only` entrance and piston combos are)
- No in-game map tracker hints - the AP client's own tracker (see above) covers this differently instead
- Gad Powers are always shuffled, with no "leave them at the temples" option (use Start Inventory From Pool if you want them guaranteed from the start)

## Known Issues
- **Beta, solo-tested only.** Expect to find things - please report them (see below)
- `cross_hub` entrance mode and Prism shuffle are not implemented yet
- Cadeaux counting is not fully reliable - some cadeaux may not register in-game depending on how they were placed. Lowering the altar cost and Fogometers door from their defaults is recommended until this is resolved

## How to Report Bugs
Bug reports, seed pathology cases, and PRs welcome. Please include your YAML (or the relevant options), the seed, and the spoiler log if one was generated - plus the exact `apply_ap_seed.py` command (or AP Companion tool steps) if the issue looks like it's on the patching side rather than generation. You can also reach me directly on Discord: bropacman.

## How to Use
1. Install Archipelago.
2. Download `shadowman.apworld` and drop it into your Archipelago install's `custom_worlds/` folder.
3. Download `shadow_man_ap_companion.exe` (no Python required) and use its "Generate YAML" tab to build your player options file.
4. Submit your YAML to the room you're generating, like any other AP game.
5. Once generated, use the Companion tool's "Apply AP Seed" tab to patch your `.apshadowman` file onto your local game install.
6. Launch `thoth_x64_patched.exe` (not the vanilla exe) and connect with the Archipelago client as usual.

Full walkthrough in the [setup guide](https://github.com/bropacman/shadow-man-remastered-ap-world/blob/main/guide_en.md).

## Requirements
- Shadow Man Remastered (Steam or GOG)
- Windows 10/11
- [Archipelago](https://archipelago.gg)

## Fixed Since v0.1.0

The initial `v0.1.0` pre-release had two real bugs that only showed up testing on a genuinely different machine, both fixed here: the AP Companion's client-launch buttons only worked for a from-source Archipelago checkout (they now support a normal installed Archipelago too, and auto-detect it), and the in-game item popup overlay silently failed to load once packaged into an actual `.apworld` file. If you already grabbed `v0.1.0`, grab this instead.

## What's New

### Goal
Defeat Legion. Reach him by collecting enough Dark Souls to open the coffin gates blocking Deadside progress and completing the five Engine Blocks (or, with Piston Combo Randomizer on, also finding and reading Jack's Schematic to learn that seed's randomized piston combination). Full [Universal Tracker](https://github.com/FarisTheAce/UniversalTracker) integration is also supported when its apworld is installed alongside this one.

### AP Companion Tool
A standalone Windows exe (`shadow_man_ap_companion.exe`, no Python required) for both ends of setup: a "Generate YAML" tab with tooltips and a live preview for building your player options file, and an "Apply AP Seed" tab for patching your generated `.apshadowman` seed onto your local game install. Its "Launch Game + Client" / "Launch Client Only" buttons auto-detect a normal installed Archipelago, so most players never have to configure anything to use them.

## How This Differs From the Standalone Randomizer
- No single graded "insanity tier" - the same ground (cadeaux, barrels, weapon/lore/bonus) is covered by separate independent options instead
- `cross_hub` entrance mode isn't ported yet (`deadside_only` entrance and piston combos are)
- No in-game map tracker hints - the AP client's own tracker (see above) covers this differently instead
- Gad Powers are always shuffled, with no "leave them at the temples" option (use Start Inventory From Pool if you want them guaranteed from the start)

## Known Issues
- **Beta, solo-tested only.** Expect to find things - please report them (see below)
- `cross_hub` entrance mode and Prism shuffle are not implemented yet
- Cadeaux counting is not fully reliable - some cadeaux may not register in-game depending on how they were placed. Lowering the altar cost and Fogometers door from their defaults is recommended until this is resolved
- Windows Smart App Control blocks the optional overlay popup DLL (in-game item toasts) on a clean Windows 11 install, since it's unsigned. Turn Smart App Control off (or switch it to Evaluation mode) if you want the popups - everything else (checks, connection, the client's own tracker) works fine either way

## How to Report Bugs
Bug reports, seed pathology cases, and PRs welcome. Please include your YAML (or the relevant options), the seed, and the spoiler log if one was generated - plus the exact `apply_ap_seed.py` command (or AP Companion tool steps) if the issue looks like it's on the patching side rather than generation. You can also reach me directly on Discord: bropacman.

## How to Use
1. Install Archipelago.
2. Download `shadowman.apworld` and drop it into your Archipelago install's `custom_worlds/` folder.
3. Download `shadow_man_ap_companion.exe` (no Python required) and use its "Generate YAML" tab to build your player options file.
4. Submit your YAML to the room you're generating, like any other AP game.
5. Once generated, use the Companion tool's "Apply AP Seed" tab to patch your `.apshadowman` file onto your local game install.
6. Launch `thoth_x64_patched.exe` (not the vanilla exe), then start and connect the client - open your installed Archipelago's own Launcher and click "Shadow Man Remastered Client" (works for everyone, no Python needed), or use the Companion's own "Launch Game + Client" / "Launch Client Only" buttons, which auto-detect a normal Archipelago install.

Full walkthrough in the [setup guide](https://github.com/bropacman/shadow-man-remastered-ap-world/blob/main/guide_en.md).

## Requirements
- Shadow Man Remastered (Steam or GOG)
- Windows 10/11
- [Archipelago](https://archipelago.gg)

v0.1.3.description:
# Shadow Man Remastered AP World v0.1.3 - Beta

Development of the AP world itself now happens in
[`shadow-man-remastered-randomizer`](https://github.com/bropacman/shadow-man-remastered-randomizer)'s
`apworld/` folder, alongside the standalone single-player randomizer
for the same game (they share the same patching engine). This repo
stays the place to come for AP world issues, downloads, and setup docs
— it's kept in sync from there, and is the one to clone if you just
want the AP world itself, without the standalone tool's own build
tooling.

## What's New Since v0.1.1

### Unique Retractor Keys
New option: splits the 5 fungible Retractors into 5 distinctly-named
items, one per liveside region (Queens, Prison, London, Florida,
Salvage Yard). Each only opens schisms in its own region instead of
any Retractor unlocking all five — lets liveside levels open
independently and often much earlier than vanilla's "any 5 opens
everything" gate. Enforced by a real exe patch (not just generation
logic), with a live-updating "Five Keys" tracker in Nettie's File (the
FBI folder document) showing which keys you've recovered.

### Cadeauxsanity (renamed from "Insanity")
Same setting, same behavior, renamed because the old name collided
with the standalone randomizer's own, differently-scoped term.
**If you have an existing YAML using `insanity:`, change it to
`cadeauxsanity:`.**

### Combine Voice & Enemy SFX
New option: when both Shuffle Voice Lines and Shuffle Enemy SFX are
on, this shuffles them together as one shared pool instead of two
separate ones. Cosmetic, off by default.

### More Varied Barrel/Cadeaux Check Placement
Which barrels get promoted to real AP checks (and how cadeaux get
grouped into bundles) is now spread more evenly across levels and
physical progression depth, not just logic-gate groups — a handful of
levels with more sub-regions/gates no longer dominate the picked set.

## Fixed Since v0.1.1

- **`.apshadowman` seed files couldn't be downloaded from a hosted AP
  room.** Generation now writes the seed as a real zip container
  instead of a bare JSON file. Old bare-JSON seeds still apply fine.
- **The packaged `.apworld` was missing its manifest file, and would
  have completely failed to load starting with Archipelago 0.7.0.**
  (It worked on 0.6.x only because older Archipelago silently
  downgrades a missing manifest to a warning instead of refusing to
  load.) Fixed — every release from here on includes a valid manifest.
- `shadowman.apworld` is ~1 MB instead of the old ~7 MB — dropped
  accidental `.git` history and doc screenshots that were never used
  at runtime.
- A handful of real generation-safety fixes found while building out
  this project's own automated test coverage for the first time (see
  "Behind the scenes" below) — nothing player-facing broke, these were
  caught before ever shipping.

## Behind the Scenes (skip if you just want the changelog)

This release is also the first one built with real CI: every push now
runs a compile-check, a check that the shared code between the
standalone randomizer and the AP world hasn't silently drifted apart,
a rebuild-and-verify of the in-game overlay DLL, and a real generation
test suite (31 tests, 1700+ sub-checks) run against an actual
Archipelago install on every change. None of this changes what you
download or how you play — it's what makes future releases more
reliable.

## Known Issues

- **Beta.** Please report anything you hit (see below).
- Location friendly names are mid-overhaul: Asylum, Deadside, and
  Louisiana Swampland have specific per-location names in checks/hints;
  the 3 Gad Temples and the 5 liveside levels (Prison, London, Queens,
  Florida, Salvage) still show generic names for now (e.g. "Cadeaux" /
  "Barrel") — functionally identical, just less descriptive until a
  future release finishes the pass.
- `cross_hub` entrance mode and Prism shuffle are not implemented yet.
- Cadeaux counting is not fully reliable — some cadeaux may not
  register in-game depending on how they were placed. Lowering the
  altar cost and Fogometers door from their defaults is recommended
  until this is resolved.
- Windows Smart App Control blocks the optional overlay popup DLL
  (in-game item toasts) on a clean Windows 11 install, since it's
  unsigned. Turn Smart App Control off (or switch it to Evaluation
  mode) if you want the popups — everything else works fine either way.

## How to Report Bugs
Bug reports, seed pathology cases, and PRs welcome. Please include your
YAML (or the relevant options), the seed, and the spoiler log if one
was generated — plus the exact `apply_ap_seed.py` command (or AP
Companion tool steps) if the issue looks like it's on the patching side
rather than generation. You can also reach me directly on Discord:
bropacman.

## How to Use
1. Install Archipelago.
2. Download `shadowman.apworld` and drop it into your Archipelago
   install's `custom_worlds/` folder.
3. Download `shadow_man_ap_companion.exe` (no Python required) and use
   its "Generate YAML" tab to build your player options file.
4. Submit your YAML to the room you're generating, like any other AP
   game.
5. Once generated, use the Companion tool's "Apply AP Seed" tab to
   patch your `.apshadowman` file onto your local game install.
6. Launch `thoth_x64_patched.exe` (not the vanilla exe), then start and
   connect the client — open your installed Archipelago's own Launcher
   and click "Shadow Man Remastered Client," or use the Companion's own
   "Launch Game + Client" / "Launch Client Only" buttons.

Full walkthrough in the [setup guide](https://github.com/bropacman/shadow-man-remastered-ap-world/blob/main/guide_en.md).

## Requirements
- Shadow Man Remastered (Steam or GOG)
- Windows 10/11
- [Archipelago](https://archipelago.gg)
